affectedCodePaths.fact: The initial master-title filter and subsequent status/stat/executable/namespace/cmdline reads are separate observations. The identity guard rejects zombie/dead state or mismatched fields; discovery tolerates ENOENT and ESRCH only.
Stop verifies identity, sends SIGQUIT, then polls inspectMaster while the master exits. Stopped-state confirmation also inspects runtime identity and remaining native group membership.
The control changes a recorded dependency hash, not a host library. The stop assertion fails before the later uninstall checks.
